context_requirements: Expression of CAMK2A or related calcium/calmodulin-dependent kinases
Intact calcium-calcineurin-NFAT signaling for immediate early gene effects
Cellular stress or death pathways competent for late apoptosis
falsifiers: No change in any immediate early gene (FOS, EGR1, JUN) at 6 h in any line
No antiproliferative or apoptosis signature at 24 h in any line
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines
Selective upregulation of CAMK2A itself without downstream pathway changes

evidence.supports: The calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase inhibitor W-7 partially blocks TNF-alpha-induced cPLA2 gene expression, indicating CAMK inhibition can attenuate inflammatory gene transcription.

changes: Removed CCL2, CXCL2, and PTGS2 from proximal_up because the cited evidence shows CAMK inhibition attenuates inflammatory gene transcription, not induces it.
Removed RRP12 from proximal_down because it is a ribosome biogenesis factor, not a proximal proliferation gene.
Removed duplicate MCM3 and PCNA from late_down because they already appear in proximal_down and must not appear in both lists.
